summary: Card Library: restore the always-visible clan icon row across the top (per Mendon's live design feedback after playtesting), replacing the Clans popover from #559. Each clan box now toggles independently (multi-select, highlighted when active) instead of the old single-select behavior; Select all/Deselect all buttons sit at the right-most end of that row. Types and Keywords keep their popover-checklist filters, now positioned in the row below alongside the Dynasty/Fate/Strongholds family buttons (their original pre-#559 slot).
